payload.text: Water agent. Main WP-GOV-01: isolate the damaged segment with the nearest valves and replace the section. Left open it costs 4,020 EGP every hour and needs 3.0 h of crew time, so each crew hour buys back 1,340 EGP an hour. If my work goes first it is done by hour 4.0. If I go first, the others together pay 25,785 EGP more.
